candidates.snippet: ## Problem  I want to run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (NVFP4, 48 layers x 512 experts) on an RTX 6000 Ada (48 GB) at a usable speed. The expert weights do not fit in GPU memory, so part of them has to live on the CPU side, but with the existing CPU offload (UVA) decode stays at about 7 tok/s. Development and measurement were done on an RTX PRO 6000 (96 GiB) with a separate process holding GPU memory so that vLLM had 48 GiB available. candidates.title: [Bug] Qwen3ForSequenceClassification retains random head bias when loading bias-free checkpoints
candidates.snippet: ## Describe the bug  `Qwen3ForSequenceClassification` creates its classification head with `nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, config.num_labels)`, which enables and initializes a bias. Loading a checkpoint containing `score.weight` but no `score.bias` leaves that initialized bias unchanged and returns without an error.
